title: DR telemetry harness, canary failover automation, and rollback playbooks
author: Lina Morales
description:
Motivation: customers running Private deployments asked for a reproducible, observable DR drill workflow that can be executed in a dry-run mode, exercised in CI, and fully rolled back automatically. This PR implements a telemetry-first DR harness and end-to-end canary failover automation plus a set of rollback playbooks as code.

What this changes (high level):
- Terraform: new module terraform/modules/dr_canary that provisions an isolated canary VPC/subnet + Kubernetes namespace + service account and exposes a lightweight canary agent (dr-canary) with ingress disabled by default. The module includes tagging and IAM policy templates for pre-authorized failover.
- Helm: updates to private-installer Helm chart to add lifecycle hooks (preFailover/postFailover), a helmValues.toggle.drDryRun boolean, and templates for dr-coordinator CronJob and dr-hook sidecar.
- Installer: private-installer binary gains a --dr-dry-run flag that simulates node evacuation and resource reallocation without touching production IPs; it also emits structured telemetry events to the telemetry endpoint.
- Telemetry harness: a new observability stack snapshot (prometheus rules, grafana dashboard, loki queries) under ops/dr-harness that captures failover latency, endpoint convergence, DB replica promotion events, and KV-cache warmup metrics.
- Rollback playbooks: ansible/playbooks/dr_rollback.yml and scripts/rollback-checker.sh implement the documented rollback semantics (detection, traffic cut, state verification, and rehydrate cache).
- Tests and CI: added a lightweight e2e workflow .github/workflows/dr-canary.yml that runs the terraform module in an ephemeral environment (using aws-account-test creds), executes the dr-canary scenario in dry-run and active modes, and validates telemetry assertions.

Why this is structured this way: the design separates provisioning (terraform) from control-plane actions (helm + installer) and from verification/telemetry (prometheus/grafana + CI). Dry-run mode allows teams to validate behavior without service disruption; the telemetry-first approach makes regressions visible in dashboards/alerts.

Rollout plan: 
1) Merge feature behind feature flag (helmValues.toggle.drEnabled=false by default).
2) Enable the dr-canary terraform module in staging tenants; run CI job and post dashboards to a shared SLO board.
3) Gradually enable drEnabled in canary tenants and run weekly DR drills.

Rollback and remediation: the ansible playbook supports two modes: automated (best-effort) and manual (guided). The rollback-checker.sh will produce a JSON report consumed by the installer to either abort or proceed with rehydrate. Included explicit guard rails to avoid automated traffic cuts unless both health-checks and telemetry predicates fail.

Files changed summary (high level): terraform/modules/dr_canary (new module), charts/private-installer/templates/dr-coordinator.yaml (new), charts/private-installer/values.yaml (patch), cmd/private-installer/main.go (dr-dry-run flag + telemetry emit), ops/dr-harness/prometheus.rules.yaml (new), ops/dr-harness/grafana/dr_dashboard.json (new), ansible/playbooks/dr_rollback.yml (new), scripts/rollback-checker.sh (new), .github/workflows/dr-canary.yml (new), docs/runbooks/dr-drill-runbook.md (new).

Quick usage (example): 
1) Add module to tf root: module "dr_canary" { source = "./modules/dr_canary" env = "staging" }
2) helm upgrade private-installer --set toggle.drDryRun=true -f values-dr-staging.yaml
3) ./private-installer --dr-dry-run run --script=ops/dr-harness/simulate-failover.json

Small snippet: helm values example to enable dry-run mode: 
{
  drEnabled: false,
  drDryRun: true,
  drCoordinator: { schedule: "@hourly" }
}

Security and safety considerations: dry-run avoids BGP/real IP reassignments and uses a canary VPC with isolated IAM. Rollback playbooks require a signed runbook token and are gated by RBAC checks in the installer.

Notes for reviewers: pay attention to the Prometheus alert predicates (prometheus.rules.yaml) and the installer --dr-dry-run code path for side-effect free behavior. The terraform module intentionally leaves credentials in the test-account role and externalizes secrets to the secrets manager.

Related: ENG-4021 (DR telemetry roadmap), SRE-121 (DR drills operational runbook).
